reason: Operator-facing observability only: adds the note tier's first three metrics (nora_note_candidates_total, nora_note_update_refused_total, nora_note_index_entries) and their call sites. Nothing changes in what Nora says or does — the tier was already on, and this is what makes an empty notebook distinguishable from a broken one. Design 27 §6.1 records why three and not the ten the spec declares.
